# Air 6.0.0 正式版 —— 渲染体系重构 + 装机反馈集中根治 5.1.0 之后累计 **60+ 次提交**，聚焦渲染体系（每游戏渲染器 + mg 全后端 FSR）与装机反馈问题根治。本版为第二个正式发行版。 ## ✨ 重点功能 - **渲染器每游戏强制单选**：设置页的全局渲染器选择退役，每个游戏在自己的设置页单独选择渲染器，未单独设置过的实例缺省"自动"（1.17+ 自动解析为 Vulkan 直连）。MobileGL 家族在渲染器列表里合并为唯一的 **mg** 条目：后端统一在 设置 > MobileGlues > 渲染后端 选择（Vulkan 直连 / GLES / OpenGL 4.0，默认 Vulkan 直连）。 - **mg 三个后端全部支持 FSR 1.0 超分**：GLES / OpenGL 4.0 后端为原生 EASU 放大 + RCAS 锐化双管线；**Vulkan 直连后端通过 Metal 呈现层拦截方案支持 FSR**（私有低分辨率交换层 + AMD FSR1 EASU/RCAS 移植到 Metal，MobileGL/MoltenVK 二进制零改动）——选择 FSR 档位即享受"低分辨率渲染 + 放大锐化"的帧率红利，Vulkan 直连推荐作为默认首选后端。 - **ES / OpenGL 4.0 黑屏根治**：强制开启的 DSA 扩展在 MobileGlues 模拟层 + FSR1 fb0 重定向下产生黑屏（多轮装机 A/B 实锤），已改回默认关闭并自动迁移存量配置。 - **新拟态 UI + 自定义背景**、**公告置顶**（推荐服务器 mysv.dpdns.org 已置顶）、**管理 Java 26.0+（Java 25）预选**、**TouchController 虚拟按钮回归**、**下载镜像策略**（默认加载速度快优先）等，完整清单见 README。 ## 🔧 装机反馈集中修复（Task 165-169） - CurseForge 加载源"无法使用"根治：镜像网关错误（上游瞬态 403/500 被包成无 data 键的 HTTP 200 JSON）不再被静默当成"无结果"——自动重试一次并把真实错误显示出来 - 本地整合包从"文件"App / 下载 / iCloud **任意位置选择即可直接安装**（不再需要先导入到应用文件） - 主页头像 **10s 超时 + 磁盘缓存秒显**（不再"要点一下才有"） - JIT 等待 **120s 超时 + 重试弹窗**（开启 JIT 偶发失败不再无限卡在"正在开启 JIT"） - Vulkan 直连首帧崩溃（交换链几何）、ES/4.0 函数解析层（gl* 符号劫持）等渲染链修复 ## 📦 安装 - 普通侧载（AltStore/SideStore/爱思助手等）：`AngelAuraAmethyst-6.0.0.ipa` - TrollStore：`AngelAuraAmethyst-6.0.0.tipa` - 首次启动游戏需要开启 JIT（设置 > JIT 里可选择 StikDebug / SideStore / JITStreamer 等工具） ## 🙏 反馈 遇到问题请上传 `latestlog.txt`（设置 > 日志）到仓库 Issues，带日志的问题基本都能一轮定位。 --- **Full changelog**: https://github.com/Gsjsjzhznsz/Air-Minecraft-iOS-Launcher/commits/main

apps.localizedDescription: A static recompilation of Skate 3 for iOS, rendering through Vulkan on MoltenVK. Runs at a locked 60fps on an iPhone 13 mini (A15): median frame 16.7ms, 95th percentile 16.8-17.8ms. YOU MUST SUPPLY THE GAME. This app contains no game content and will not start without it. AFTER INSTALLING: 1. Connect your iPhone to a computer and open Finder > your iPhone > Files > Skate 3 (on Windows, iTunes > File Sharing). 2. Drop in a 'game' folder containing your own disc files. That is about 6GB, so allow a few minutes. 3. Add Title Update 3, the free update EA published on Xbox Live - it is not on the disc and the game will not run without it. The app can download it for you: choose "Install the title update" and then Download. If you would rather supply it yourself, copy the package into the same Skate 3 folder and it is found automatically. The setup screens walk you through steps 2 and 3. On-screen touch controls appear when no controller is attached; MFi and Bluetooth controllers are picked up automatically. Press Start + Select together for a performance menu that shows your frame rate and what is limiting it. Requires iOS 16.0 or later.

versions.localizedDescription: # Skate 3 Recompiled v2.7.1 — iOS iOS skipped a release. Everything Android got in v0.2.0 is here, plus two iOS-specific defaults. 24 engine commits and 17 SDK commits since v2.6.3. ## Put any button anywhere Full controller remapping, on the Controls page under **Button Mapping**. Sixteen inputs — the four face buttons, both bumpers, both triggers, both stick clicks, Back, Start and the four D-pad directions — can each be moved to any of the others. Your mapping is saved and survives an update. The sticks themselves are not remapped; Swap Sticks and Invert Camera Y already cover that. ## Three bugs that were costing you frames **Touching the frame-rate row uncapped the game.** One setting's name was a prefix of another's (`..._fps_cap` inside `..._fps_cap_auto`), so changing the Framerate Cap row erased the shipped cap entirely, on every launch after you touched that row. The game then ran the guest loop uncapped. On Android that also meant rendering roughly twice the frames the panel could show and dumping the rest as heat, which is what "runs at 60, drops after a few minutes" was there; iOS presents through FIFO, so the cost here is wasted work rather than heat. **"The frame rate is fine but it feels like slow motion."** Skate 3 advances exactly one refresh period of simulation per rendered frame, however long that frame took, so a 33 ms frame runs the game at half speed. The ceiling that lets a frame advance more than one period (skate3_frame_advance_cap) had been compiled for Switch only — iOS and Android, the two platforms whose frames overrun the period most, never got it. It is compiled in on iOS now. Being straight about this one: the clamp is in and reachable, but raising it was measured as changing nothing on hardware, so treat it as a lever that now exists rather than a fix you are guaranteed to feel. **A profiler was running in every build.** A per-packet GPU timer took two clock reads and two atomic increments on every command packet — around 1.7 million clock reads a second on the busiest thread — whether or not anyone was profiling. It is off unless you ask for it. ## First launch could come up blank Roughly one clean install in ten reached the setup screen with an empty options list and no way forward. Parts of a screen drawn once while their shaders were still compiling were skipped and never came back — and the difficulty prompt is drawn exactly once. Shader compilation now stays synchronous through the cold-boot frontend, so nothing can draw before it is ready. ## New in Settings Eleven new rows, most of them aimed at buying frames back on a phone: - **3D Scene Resolution** — Full / 75% / 67% / 50% / 40%, separate from UI sharpness - **Draw Distance** — now goes down to Quarter and Eighth - **NPC Update Rate** and **World Update Rate** - **Pedestrians & Traffic**, **Movable Props**, **Other Skaters** — stop the world spawning crowds you are not looking at (all three need a restart) - **Vegetation**, **Hair Detail**, **Water Effects**, **Draw Batching** - **Framerate Cap** — 40, 45 and 50 added (40 divides 120 Hz, 45 divides 90 Hz) - **FPS Percentiles** — the 1% low and p95/p99 next to the average (darchap's, see Credit). Known limitation on the three population cuts: they remove the bodies, not the gameplay objects behind them, so you may still hear pedestrians, traffic and other skaters you cannot see. Being worked on. The average is exactly the statistic that hides a stutter: a steady 60 and a 60 that drops four frames a second read the same. ## Two changed defaults on iOS - **Draw distance now ships at Half.** The static world is roughly 750 of the 765 things drawn in a frame, so it is the only content lever with real weight behind it. The trade is real: props, street furniture and foliage pop in closer than they did in 2.6.3. **Settings > Video > Draw Distance > Original** puts it back. **This applies to new installs only.** If you are updating, your existing draw distance is kept exactly as it is — the

MeleePad 0.2.2 for iPhone and iPad. The app below contains no game code: PadMint adds your game module, made on your Apple Silicon Mac from your own Super Smash Bros. Melee (GALE01) disc, and saves your MeleePad IPA. ### What's new - Opens on iOS and iPadOS 27. Apps built with Xcode 27 have to start through UIKit scenes, or iOS 27 stops them at launch. MeleePad now starts through a scene (#42); pausing, resuming and the save flush when you leave the app work as before. Checked: the app below declares its scene and passes the package checks; not yet checked on a physical iOS 27 device. ### Get it Open PadMint (0.3.9 or newer), choose MeleePad and your own disc image, and follow the page. The full steps are in the [README](https://github.com/chrissotraidis/meleepad#readme). Already have MeleePad? Install the new copy over it with the same tool and Apple ID; your saves stay. ### Files - `MeleePad-v0.2.2-ios-unsigned.ipa`: the app without game code. PadMint uses it; it can't play by itself. - `MeleePad-v0.2.2-padmint.json`: the recipe PadMint follows for this version. - `SHA256SUMS`: checksums.
First release!
Multiplayer works too, you can play with PC users by joining the same servers.

versions.localizedDescription: ## MCX360 Edition 1.1 ### New - **On-screen touch controls**, using the layout from the XeniOS emulator. They show when no controller is connected and hide when one connects. Adjust them with `touch_controls`, `touch_controls_opacity` and `touch_haptics` in `mc360.toml`. - **Save thumbnails**: your worlds now show a picture in the world list. - **Exit Game** now closes the app instead of leaving a black screen. ### Performance - Much lower CPU load while playing. The game's threads no longer queue up on a shared lock, calls inside the game run directly, and waits end as soon as the GPU is ready instead of sleeping in whole milliseconds. - Frame rate capped at a steady, evenly paced 60 FPS (`framerate_limit`, default 60). - The game's main thread and GPU thread now get priority on the iPhone's performance cores. - Less heat: the game no longer spins a core at full power while waiting for the GPU, and no longer copies the whole screen image back and forth several times per frame. ### Fixes - Fixed random crashes after playing for a while. - Fixed choppy audio. - Fixed "ghost" blocks and old terrain showing where the world had changed. - Devices with 3 GB of RAM now show an explanation at launch instead of crashing. ### Known issues - Long sessions heat the phone, and iOS then slows it down, so the frame rate can drop over time. Playing unplugged and without a case helps. - The on-screen D-pad's up arrow sits over the first world's thumbnail in the Load menu. It's part of the controls, not the save. - Devices with 3 GB of RAM (iPhone 8 Plus, iPhone X, iPad 8th gen) can't run the game with a normal sideload. They need TrollStore, or a signing method that grants the Extended Virtual Addressing entitlement. Installing over 1.0 keeps your worlds and settings.

# DukeX v1.0.2 - Expanding the Xbox Experience DukeX v1.0.2 is our biggest step yet toward preserving the full original Xbox experience, not just the games. This release introduces the first native macOS build, expands XB.Live integration, and brings richer community features to both iOS and macOS. ## What's New - Native macOS release: DukeX is now available as a Mac Catalyst desktop build packaged with a nested Xemu fork, pairing desktop Xemu compatibility with the DukeX interface. - XB.Live Rich Presence and playtime tracking: friends can see what you are playing while DukeX tracks supported playtime sessions. - XB.Live messaging: threaded conversations, friend messaging, unread indicators, supported game invites, and existing Xbox inbox support now live inside DukeX. - XB.Live social expansion: friend requests, friend management, online presence, and deeper community integration are available from the Profile experience. - Activity Feed: XB.Live news, friend online status, friend achievement unlocks, and community updates now appear in a continuously refreshed timeline. - Controller Landscape Mode: on iOS, compatible controllers can switch DukeX into a controller-first browsing and launch experience. - Expanded AirPlay and external display support: big-screen play is more reliable across supported display configurations. ## Improvements - Improved achievements with Games, Apps, and Cores grouping plus updated artwork handling for XB.Live Core, DukeX Core, and special test titles. - Improved game tile spacing and cover handling across iOS and macOS. - Improved XB.Live cloud-save sync metadata with console identity v2, content-hash dedupe, and server-assisted cross-console restore handling. - Fixed achievement progress rounding so time-based achievements do not show 100% before they are actually complete. ## Availability - iOS: install `DukeX.v1.0.2.ipa` through StikStore, SideStore, or another supported sideloading workflow. - macOS: install `DukeX.macOS.v1.0.2.dmg` by dragging DukeX to Applications. - Hardware requirements on iOS remain Apple A14 Bionic or Apple M1 hardware or newer. - iOS 16.0 or later is supported, with iOS 16 support remaining experimental. ## Important DukeX does not include Xbox system files, game images, BIOS files, copyrighted content, signing certificates, or user games. Users must provide their own legally obtained files. DukeX is intended for legitimate emulation, preservation, testing, and personal library use.
